name: Sellix API
tagline: Digital product storefront API with crypto and card payments for automated ecom stores.
description: Sellix provides a REST API for managing digital product storefronts, orders, products, and payments including cryptocurrency and card payments. Developers can automate e-commerce operations, retrieve order data, manage inventory, and integrate payment processing for digital goods.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header, obtained from Sellix dashboard settings.

use_cases: list digital products in a store
create a payment invoice for a product
check payment status for an order
